surface: Complete against the pinned @monaco-editor/react 4.8.0-rc.3 public surface: default Editor, DiffEditor, loader re-export, useMonaco, Monaco/Theme types, and Editor/DiffEditor prop/callback types. @monaco-editor/loader is reused unchanged.
divergences: loading accepts OctaneNode | string instead of React.ReactNode.
Internal MonacoContainer uses Octane ref on the host div; upstream's private _ref prop is not carried forward.
'use client' directives are omitted; editors remain browser-only via effects.
CSS style objects use plain records rather than React.CSSProperties.
ssr: Supported and tested: Editor/DiffEditor server-render the loading shell (section + Loading) and do not call loader.init or monaco.editor.create on the server. hydrateRoot adopts that shell; client effects run init afterward.
notes: monaco-editor peer range matches upstream (>= 0.25.0 < 1). Oracle pin is monaco-editor@0.56.0.
Upstream Vitest suite is snapshot-only (4 files). Port-authored lifecycle, differential, SSR/hydration, Chromium browser, and example e2e supply behavioral parity.
Library onChange prop name is preserved (model content callback), not rewritten to onInput.

Worker configuration stays in the consuming app. v1 default (examples/monaco-playground + package Chromium harness) is npm monaco-editor@0.56.0 via Vite MonacoEnvironment + ?worker and loader.config({ monaco }); CDN AMD paths remain a documented alternate in README.
